completeness.why: forecast passes its (already non-null) value straight to the new helper; post-transaction and preview call it but keep their own `== null ? 0 :` dispatch, a case the decision includes and the existing getScheduledAmount already decides; updateActions in server/schedules/app.ts and runSchedule in schedule-template.ts are untouched and keep their own copies (the template's halve-the-rounded-sum variant is not made an explicit parameter).

interface.why: The new getExpectedScheduleAmount covers only number/range and leaves the missing case to callers, ignores the existing exported getScheduledAmount that already decides all three cases, and offers no explicit variant for the template's different rounding.

disguised_duplication.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts is a renamed reimplementation of the existing getScheduledAmount (minus inverse and null handling) in the same file, so the rule now has two shared definitions plus the untouched copies in updateActions and schedule-template.
